blocks.title: Space complexity
blocks.text: Space complexity naapti hai ke input ka size barhne par algorithm ki istemal shuda memory kaise badalti hai. Ise bhi Big O notation mein oopri had ke taur par likha jata hai.

items: O(1) constant space: muqarrar miqdar, jaise darmiyani qeematon ke liye chand variables.
O(n) linear space: memory input ke saath barhti hai, jaise cheezon ki list rakhna.
O(n^2) quadratic space: n x n matrix rakhna.
O(log n) logarithmic space: kuch divide-and-conquer algorithms har qadam par data ka chhota hissa rakhte hain.

blocks.text: Memory ka kaarkard istemal bare applications aur kam memory wale nizamon mein sab se ahem hai. Big O bad-tareen soorat bayan karta hai, aur batata hai ke input barhne par algorithm kaisa chalega (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Time aur space complexity ke farq aur algorithm ke intikhab par un ke asar par baat kijiye (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: Time complexity naapti hai ke input ke saath waqt kaise barhta hai; space complexity ke memory ka istemal kaise barhta hai. Algorithm tez magar zyada memory wala, ya kam memory wala magar sust ho sakta hai, to intikhab hadon par munhasir hai: tez server par bohat bare data ke liye waqt sab se ahem, jabke kam memory wale aale par O(1)-space algorithm behtar ho sakta hai chahe sust ho. Maslan merge sort O(n log n) waqt leta magar jorne ke liye izafi memory chahta hai, jabke bubble sort sirf O(1) izafi jagah leta magar O(n^2) waqt.

items: Space complexity: memory ki barhotri (O(1) chand variables, O(n) list, O(n^2) matrix, O(log n)).
Waqt aur memory ki hadon mein tawazun kar ke algorithm chunein.
